title: Maximum Consecutive Price Increases
scenario: Find the maximum number of times a product's price increased consecutively.
tableSchema: products (product_id INT, new_price INT, change_date DATE)
hint: Use window functions to define groups (islands) of increases.
correctQuery: SELECT product_id, MAX(streak) AS max_inc_streak FROM (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS streak FROM (SELECT product_id, change_date, SUM(is_increase) OVER(PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY change_date) AS grp FROM (SELECT product_id, change_date, CASE WHEN new_price > LAG(new_price, 1, 0) OVER(PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY change_date) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_increase FROM products) t) t2 GROUP BY product_id, grp) t3 GROUP BY product_id;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE products (product_id INT, new_price INT, change_date DATE);
